Explore SAT Suite Benefits We value your privacyWe use cookies and other tracking technologies to operate the site, enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized content or ads about our programs, and analyze our traffic, consistent with your choices and as described in our Cookie Notice. We use strictly necessary cookies to make our site work. By continuing to browse or by clicking “Accept All”, you consent to ALL of our website’s cookie use as described in our Cookie Notice. This includes marketing cookies and other non-essential cookies to improve website performance and enhance its functionality. By clicking “Reject Optional”, you reject all non-essential cookies. By clicking on “Manage Cookies”, you can learn more and further control your preferences for cookies that are not strictly necessary. You can manage your options at any time through a “Manage Cookies” link at the footer of a College Board webpage or a floating cookie icon at the bottom of your screen while on our website. Please review our Cookie Notice for further details. Privacy StatementAccept AllReject OptionalManage CookiesYour Opt Out Preference Signal is HonoredCookie Preference CenterWhen you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies and other technologies such as beacons, pixels, tags, scripts and other tracking technologies (“Cookies”). The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of Cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change settings. However, blocking some types of Cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer. More information Manage Consent PreferencesStrictly Necessary CookiesAlways ActiveStrictly Necessary Cookies are essential for the website to function and cannot be turned off. They include security, accessibility, network management and those set in response to actions made by you for a request for services, such as setting your cookie preferences or authentication. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these Cookies, but some parts of the site will not function.Performance Cookies Performance Cookies Performance Cookies allow us to track visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these Cookies collect is aggregated and anonymous. If you do not allow these Cookies we will not be able to monitor its performance.Functional Cookies Functional Cookies Functional Cookies enable enhanced functionality and personalization. They help to remember choices you make or information you enter (such as your username). They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these Cookies then some or all of these functions may not operate properly.Marketing Cookies Marketing Cookies Marketing Cookies may be used to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant messaging from College Board on College Board’s site and other sites, about College Board’s programs and services. We may also use these Cookies to help measure the effectiveness of our engagement campaigns and conduct market research. These Cookies may be set through our site by us or the channels we leverage. They do not store directly personal information but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device.In addition, depending on where you live, you may have the right to request College Board to delete your personally identifiable information.
